range_rationale.same_window_control: A same-window no-ATR comparison is required so drawdown improvement is not inferred from prior full-history results.
range_rationale.atr_stop: ATR stop is selected because current compiler and validator support a closed bar-close ATR stop. Multipliers 2.0 and 3.0 are narrow, standard volatility-stop distances that test tighter versus looser risk control without a broad optimizer grid.
range_rationale.max_hold_bars: The prior max-hold values remain part of the frozen signal/exit denominator and are not retuned.
range_rationale.sizing: Dynamic equity target leverage at 1.0 is the repo's current comparable offline measurement mode; leverage is not swept to avoid mechanical drawdown reduction being mistaken for edge.
